PC Errata 2019 disc card of [[For Luck]]: the full card image the Players Committee served in its starwarsccg.org card lists, with a small round bronze disc at the lower right of the game-text box. Source: Players Committee card image [https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/JediPack-Light/large/forluck.gif forluck.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists.
